title: Eval case
description: Documented shape of an eval/cases/<id>.json file. Informational only — enforced in code by D365FO.Core.Eval.EvalCaseCatalog, not by a JSON-Schema validator (no such library is referenced anywhere else in this repo).

id.description: Tier prefix (L0-L4) must match the 'tier' field.

instruction.description: Natural-language instruction for the eval-runner agent to drive through the d365fo CLI/MCP tool surface unassisted.

canonical_args.description: Optional. Full `d365fo` args (e.g. ["generate", "edt", "Name", "--base-type", "String"]) for the deterministic `eval run` replay path. Must NOT include --out/--overwrite/--install-to/--output — `eval run` supplies those (the last forced to json, so the replay never touches Spectre's AnsiConsole). Omit for instruction-only cases (agent-driven via `eval score` only).

target_artifact_types.description: AOT kinds this case produces, e.g. ["AxEdt"].

golden_path.description: Directory name under eval/goldens/ holding exactly one captured *.xml golden.

ignore.description: Golden-diff path globs to ignore (e.g. legitimately variable nodes). * = any run of characters, ** = same, spanning '/'.

requires_fixture_index.description: True when the case extends/references an object from tests/Samples/MiniAot (e.g. a CoC wrapper). `eval run` builds a disposable temp index from that fixture before replaying.

golden_pending.description: True once authored but before the golden has been captured (`d365fo eval capture`) and reviewed.
